info.title: Vitrina Timpului — Museum API
info.description: CRUD REST API for the Bălți museum exhibition. All `/api/*` routes require a Bearer JWT obtained from `POST /token`.

get.description: Public endpoint. Returns a signed JWT valid for `JWT_EXPIRES_IN` (default 60 s).

post.description: Public endpoint. Role defaults to `VISITOR` when omitted.

get.summary: Get leaderboard for a game key

200.description: Top entries (max 20, sorted by score desc)

delete.summary: Clear leaderboard for one key (DELETE permission)
Clear ALL leaderboards (DELETE permission — admin only)
